title: Jubilant Venezuelan Bread Stew
description: A hearty one pot dish featuring white bread and flambe, this stew is a twist on traditional Venezuelan cuisine, made FODMAP friendly and cooked to perfection in a kadhai.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a kadhai over medium heat.
Add the onion and cook until it is translucent.
Add the garlic free seasoning, salt, and black pepper, and stir to combine.
Add the red wine and bring to a flambe, cooking until the liquid is almost completely reduced.
Add the chicken broth and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and add the white bread, stirring to combine.
Cook for 10 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the bread is chewy and the liquid is mostly absorbed.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
Ensure poultry is cooked to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F (juices run clear, no pink remaining) before serving.
